---
# DRAFT copy for Douglas's approval before launch (README, "Launch checklist").
# No `title`: the hero (R/site_summary.R) is the page's title block, with
# the name as its h1; pagetitle gives the <title>.
pagetitle: "Translational physician-scientist for public health"
description: "Douglas Fritz is an MD/PhD researcher working across climate change, infectious disease, medicine and health-professional education. Research pillars, selected publications and talks, and where the talks were hosted."
# The research-pillar component (_pillars.qmd, rendered by R at build time);
# js/pillars.js enhances it. Person structured data: Home and About only
# (includes/person-jsonld.html holds approved public identity fields only, no
# email address or telephone; tests/testthat/test-site-content.R checks its
# values against data/site.yml and _quarto.yml).
include-in-header:
  - text: <script type="module" src="js/pillars.js"></script>
  - file: includes/person-jsonld.html
---

```{r}
#| label: site-setup
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# The hero, Selected work, the reach summary and the closing links are built
# at build time by R/site_summary.R from data/site.yml and the public
# generated data. Each chunk returns its block (knitr::asis_output), which
# keeps non-ASCII text UTF-8 in any locale.
root <- Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR")
if (!nzchar(root)) stop("Render this page with Quarto from the project (QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR is not set).")
site_code <- new.env()
for (file in c("config.R", "pillar_cards.R", "site_summary.R")) sys.source(file.path(root, "R", file), envir = site_code)
```

```{r}
#| label: home-hero

knitr::asis_output(site_code$home_hero_block(root))
```

::: {.home-lead}
I work at the intersection of climate change, infectious disease, medicine and health-professional education. My doctoral research combines experimental virology, epidemiology and evolutionary modelling, and I help translate climate-health evidence into education, communication and action across health-professional networks.
:::
